priority: Blizzard announcements, patch notes, and observed in-game behavior
phase-matched Questie data and runtime corrections
a second compatible structured addon dataset
an independent authored route used only for route comparison
archived/community evidence with an explicit version limitation
rationale: The public gate is risk-based. Pinned phase-aware Questie data is authoritative for ordinary identity and dependency structure; official Blizzard evidence controls the selected phase; independently authored routes corroborate placement where they overlap; emitted travel coordinates require stronger provenance; and behavior that depends on the live client remains an in-game gate. Requiring a second source for every excluded or low-risk catalog row would not materially improve player safety and would overstate community sources as independent authorities.
